summary: The LEP program needs to go. It makes no for the students @scsu caters to and does not fit the @ccsunews vision of a unified system. We require nine credits of foreign language (only university) because a motion was tabled in Sentae years ago.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: The LEP program needs to go. It makes no for the students @scsu caters to and does not fit the @ccsunews vision of a unified system. We require nine credits of foreign language (only university) because a motion was tabled in Sentae years ago.
